description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹企業永續發展的核心概念、原則和實踐。課程審視永續發展在商業中的作用，探索其經濟、社會和環境效益，並為學生提供將永續發展納入企業決策的策略和工具。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the core concepts, principles, and practices of sustainable development in the corporate sector. It examines sustainability's role in business, explores its economic, social, and environmental benefits, and equips students with strategies and tools to integrate sustainability into corporate decision-making.

targets.describe_ch: 學生需要獲得有關永續發展概念和商業永續發展歷史的基礎知識。
targets.describe_en: Students need to acquire foundational knowledge about sustainable development concepts and the history of sustainability in business.

targets.describe_ch: 學生應了解企業社會責任（CSR）、環境永續性、社會永續性以及永續企業發展中的治理和道德原則。
targets.describe_en: Students should understand the principles of corporate social responsibility (CSR), environmental sustainability, social sustainability, and governance and ethics in sustainable corporate development.

targets.describe_ch: 學生需要將他們的知識和理解應用到現實世界的場景和案例研究中。他們應該能夠分析企業面臨的永續發展挑戰並提出切實可行的解決方案。
targets.describe_en: Students must apply their knowledge and comprehension to real-world scenarios and case studies. They should be able to analyze sustainability challenges businesses face and propose practical solutions.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: Students are required to participate the on-line classes and submit the homework assigned by the teacher 1, which accounts for 33% of your final grade.
gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Students are required to present the proposal at the 10th week and 15th week, contributing to 20% of the final grade. These reports should include the preliminary analysis, personal insights, and constructive feedback for enhancement.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: At the onset of the semester, students will be grouped to collaboratively engage in preparing and discussing semester project reports, culminating in oral presentations towards the term's end. This collaborative endeavor, constituting 50% of the final grade, requires students to collectively develop and present their project outcomes. An evaluative competition will be conducted to distinguish and commend exemplary presentations.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Expected classroom behavior
(1) Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
(2) All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
(3) You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loud enough to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
